notes: Tests described in ROUNDTABLE_PROGRESS.md (87 tests across 6 files) are NOT committed to the repo. Only test_simple.py exists. Core finding: InvestigationState.add_fact() stores facts as flat strings with fuzzy dedup only. No typed assertions, no speech-act classification, no support/attack links, no persistence. This is the exact gap SO-2 targets. The investigate_loop accumulates findings in-memory; on completion, everything is lost. The _orient() phase puts issues into findings[issues] as list[str] - no structured issue tree.
